subject: Demo recording & slides — quick 20-minute Q&A?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasai.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recording & slides — quick 20-minute Q&A?

Hi Liam / Nina,

Thanks again for your time earlier — great to learn more about AtlasAI's ingestion pipeline and the latency concerns you're tracking. As promised, attached is the recording of today's demo and the slides we reviewed.

Quick recap / proposed next steps:
- Recording + slides attached for your team to share internally.
- I can run a focused 20-minute Q&A to walk through the SDK integration details and latency tuning ideas (no sales pitch, just technical).
- Suggested slots: Wed 6/30 9:30–10:00 PT, Thu 7/1 11:00–11:30 PT, or Fri 7/2 14:00–14:30 PT. If none of these work, propose a time that does.

If AtlasAI is still prioritizing inference cost/latency improvements for H2, this Q&A should help your engs evaluate the effort to pilot Redwood. If timing has shifted, no problem — tell me when would be better and I can follow up later.

Attachments:
- atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (recording of demo, ~12m)
- atlas-demo-slides.pdf (12 slides, architecture & perf notes)

Recording link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abc123/view?usp=sharing
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

---
NOTE: If you prefer I loop an engineer from our Solutions team for the Q&A, let me know and I will add them.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recording & slides — quick 20-minute Q&A?

Hi Liam —

Just bumping this in case it got buried. Wanted to check whether any of the 20-minute slots I suggested (Wed/Thu/Fri this week) could work for a quick technical Q&A with your engs. Happy to schedule outside those times if better for you.

If you're not the right person to coordinate, could you point me to whoever owns infra/ML inference at AtlasAI?

Thanks —
Marissa

(On Jul 1, Marissa sent the recording and slides.)

Hi Liam —

Bumping one more time. Is this still a priority for AtlasAI this quarter? If timing has shifted to later in July/Aug, totally fine — let me know and I’ll follow up then. If it is still a priority, I can drop a calendar invite for one of the suggested slots or coordinate with your ops team.

If helpful: I can include one of our Solutions Engineers on a 20-minute call to go deeper into the adapter and batching suggestions we discussed.

Cheers,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — apologies for the delay, been heads-down this week.

We are still interested and the Q&A makes sense. Wed Jul 7 10:00–10:20 PT works for our infra lead (Nina) and me. Could you send a calendar invite for that slot? Please include your SE if possible — Nina would like someone who can speak to latency tuning and KV cache behavior.

I'll review the recording this afternoon and share any specific items we want covered.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
VP Product, AtlasAI
